node_route:
# Generated by the provisioner: stack links of muster.
http:
  routers:
    pc-s-muster--links:
      rule: 'Host(`links-muster.castorapps.ch`)'
      entryPoints: [web]
      middlewares: [castor-control-plane]
      service: pc-s-muster--links
  services:
    pc-s-muster--links:
      loadBalancer:
        passHostHeader: true
        servers:
          - url: "http://web.pc-s-muster--links:9090"
middlewares:
# Generated by the provisioner: requests must come from the control plane.
http:
  middlewares:
    castor-control-plane:
      ipAllowList:
        sourceRange: ["10.0.0.1", "10.0.0.2"]
control_plane:
# Generated by the provisioner: muster's custom stacks, on the node at http://10.0.0.40:8480.
http:
  routers:
    pc-s-muster--links:
      rule: 'Host(`links-muster.castorapps.ch`)'
      entryPoints: [websecure]
      middlewares: [castor-stack-strip@file, castor-stack-auth@file]
      service: pc-s-muster--node
      tls:
        certResolver: le
        domains:
          - main: 'castorapps.ch'
            sans: ['*.castorapps.ch']
    pc-s-muster--links-outpost:
      rule: 'Host(`links-muster.castorapps.ch`) && PathPrefix(`/outpost.goauthentik.io/`)'
      entryPoints: [websecure]
      priority: 10000
      service: authentik@docker
      tls:
        certResolver: le
        domains:
          - main: 'castorapps.ch'
            sans: ['*.castorapps.ch']
    pc-s-muster--tools:
      rule: 'Host(`tools-muster.castorapps.ch`)'
      entryPoints: [websecure]
      middlewares: [castor-stack-strip@file, castor-stack-auth@file]
      service: pc-s-muster--node

        certResolver: le
        domains:
          - main: 'castorapps.ch'

    pc-s-muster--tools-outpost:

      priority: 10000

        domains:
          - main: 'castorapps.ch'
            sans: ['*.castorapps.ch']
  services:

        passHostHeader: true
        servers:
